events.did: wiped the tears from his eyes and said that to see the stars again he will just have to survive
events.quote_anchor: “OH, well,” said Eli, wiping the tears from his eyes. “If I want to see the stars again, I’ll just have to survive.”

events.did: turned his nerves up until the rooftop vision splintered and broke apart, taking Eli with it
events.quote_anchor: But the rest remembered he had work to do. He caught hold of his nerves and turned them up until the vision splintered, broke apart, taking Eli with it.

events.did: shot two EON agents who were lost inside Serena's dream
events.quote_anchor: But instead of surging toward him, one just stood there, facing the wall, while the other drifted aimlessly. Both lost inside Serena’s dream.

events.did: tried to shoot an EO but was pinned in place by a force that vised around his arm
events.quote_anchor: Victor went to shoot the EO, but when he tried to lift the gun, a force vised suddenly around his arm, pinning it in place.

events.did: took hold of the nerves inside the EO's injured hand and turned them up as far as they would go
events.quote_anchor: He took hold of the nerves inside the EO’s injured hand and turned them up as far as they would go.

events.did: reached out and blew the EO's fuses, and the man went down and did not get back up
events.quote_anchor: Victor smiled through the pain. He didn’t have the air to say no, so he didn’t bother, just reached out, and blew the EO’s fuses.

events.did: was hit by an electric current bright enough to make the world go white and make his heart lose rhythm
events.quote_anchor: Electricity shot through him. A sudden, shocking current, bright enough to make the world go white. To make his heart lose rhythm

events.did: swung his hand up with finger pointed and said “Bang”, then snapped his fingers to blow the female EO's fuses
events.quote_anchor: Victor didn’t wait for her to finish. He’d dropped the gun, but he still swung his hand up, finger pointed, and said, “Bang.”

relations.did: is on a familiar mission to reach Gabriel's office, which lies at the center of the EON compound, using the layout Mitch showed him
relations.quote_anchor: Victor had moved, while in the dream, and it took a moment to orient himself, to call to mind the layout Mitch had showed him.

relations.did: spoke to Victor from a speaker hidden in the walls of his green-walled office
relations.quote_anchor: “Welcome to EON, Victor Vale. I’m so glad you decided to come.”

relations.did: had trained Victor, and he was grateful he had listened to her about cardio
relations.quote_anchor: He was grateful he’d listened to Dani, at least when it came to cardio.

relations.did: had turned his talents to ExtraOrdinaries as well as ordinary puppets
relations.quote_anchor: The ordinary puppets were bad enough, but Gabriel had clearly turned his talents to ExtraOrdinaries, too.

numbers.did: found himself face-to-face with two EON agents (原文: two EON agents)
numbers.quote_anchor: As Victor rounded the first corner, he found himself face-to-face with two EON agents.

numbers.did: made two more turns before reaching Gabriel's office (原文: Two more turns)
numbers.quote_anchor: Two more turns, and he made it to Gabriel’s office, felt the EO’s energy beyond the door.

numbers.did: felt the ache recede behind a dozen other shallow pains (原文: a dozen other shallow pains)
numbers.quote_anchor: the ache receded behind a dozen other shallow pains as he retrieved the gun and continued down the hall

numbers.did: said that one of his patients wanted to say hello (原文: one of my patients)
numbers.quote_anchor: “Oh, I do. And we will. When you’re in a less … combative state. In the meantime, one of my patients wanted to say hello.”

numbers.did: saw two worlds superimposed while Eli held the roof door open (原文: The two worlds)
numbers.quote_anchor: The two worlds, superimposed as Eli held the roof door open.
